properties.name: picsure.gateway.health.status-window-ms
properties.description: Throttle window, in milliseconds, during which GET /system/status reuses the last computed deep-health result instead of re-running SystemHealthService's check.

properties.name: picsure.gateway.allowed-client-types
properties.description: X-Client-Type values the gateway accepts from callers, matched case-insensitively. A request carrying any other value is rejected with 400 unexpected_caller_type; an absent header is recorded as UNKNOWN. The reserved values mcp and service cannot be listed.
